app_subtitle: Formative feedback from prototype heuristics and optional LLM support — not automatic scoring.
app_prototype_warning: This prototype is not educationally validated, does not measure proficiency, and does not replace teacher judgment.
app_deepseek_configured: Feedback provider: DeepSeek is configured. LocalDemo is used only if the API request or response validation fails.
app_deepseek_no_key: Feedback provider: DeepSeek is selected, but no API key was loaded by the running API process. Restart after saving the local .env file.
app_analyzer_fallback: The requested NLP analyzer is unavailable; the API will record and use BasicAnalyzer fallback.
app_api_unavailable: Analyzer status will appear after the local API is available.
app_provider_local_demo: LocalDemo is explicitly selected for this running API process.
view_student_help: Student view hides internal gates and raw provider diagnostics.
task_revision_within: Submit a revision within an existing task
task_revision_help: A revision remains part of one writing task and does not add a cross-task observation.
time_limit_help: Editable at all times; saved only when Timed writing is selected.
active_duration_help: This is separate from the task time limit. Output rate is unavailable when actual duration is not recorded.
submission_enter_info: Enter a pseudonymous student ID, task information, and an English draft to begin.
submission_choose_revision: Choose the earlier draft explicitly before submitting this revision.
submission_similar_prompt: A similar prompt already exists. Confirm whether this is a new independent task or another revision.
submission_error: The submission could not be completed. No API key or internal stack is displayed.
api_unavailable: The local feedback API is unavailable. Start run.bat and try again.
no_selected_priority: No diagnostic signal was selected after gate and confidence evaluation.
no_targeted_practice: No exercise was generated for this submission.
calf_student_boundary: Research measures are available for audit but are not writing scores.
calf_no_measures: No stored measure is available for this construct in the current AnalysisRun.
calf_accuracy_unavailable: Accuracy measures are unavailable unless eligible confirmed human or imported-corpus error annotations exist. No missing annotation is reported as zero errors.
calf_sophistication_unavailable: Unavailable: no authorized versioned frequency resource and complete operating definition are configured.
calf_candidate_note: T-unit and clause outputs remain automatic candidates and are not formal syntactic-complexity measures.
practice_not_available: Practice not available for this target.
no_active_target: No active practice target. Submit an essay to receive feedback first.
practice_boundary: Practice completion does not prove mastery or learning.
transfer_boundary: One observation is not proof of stable transfer.
empty_events: No observable events recorded yet. Submit an essay with feedback first.
enter_student_id: Enter a student ID to view observable events.
journey_caption: Observable events timeline. An attempt is not learning. A response candidate is not mastery.
audit_caption: Research view: complete practice audit trail.
all_descriptive: All observations are descriptive candidates. None establishes learning, mastery, or stable transfer.
research_audit_subtitle: Diagnostic audit, learner model, reanalysis, and administration tools.
research_audit_reanalysis_note: Reanalysis preview and execution tools are available when the API is running with an active database.
split_boundary: This dataset split is infrastructure only and does not indicate suitability for model training.
privacy_warning: This export contains internal student IDs. Mark as restricted local research data.
research_data_filters_placeholder: Dataset filter configuration is available through the export preview.
research_overview_subtitle: Aggregate counts, provider status, and data-quality warnings.
research_overview_no_dq: Data quality report is not available.
research_evidence_subtitle: Submission, analysis, diagnosis, and evidence audit.
research_evidence_prompt: Enter a submission ID and click Load to inspect evidence records.
research_calf_no_result: Submit an essay first to view CALF measures.
research_learning_subtitle: Complete evidence chain: targets, exercises, attempts, evaluations, engagement, transfer.
student_home_subtitle: Your writing tasks, latest feedback, and next steps.
student_home_enter_id: Enter your student ID to see your tasks and recommendations.
student_home_no_submissions: No writing tasks yet. Go to Writing to submit your first essay.
student_home_no_events: No feedback events yet. Submit an essay from the Writing page.
student_home_action_submit: Submit your first essay on the Writing page to get started.
student_home_action_practice: Complete the available practice activity on the Practice page.
student_home_action_revise: Consider submitting a revision based on your feedback on the Revision page.
student_home_action_new_task: Try a new independent writing task on the Writing page.
student_home_action_continue: Continue writing and revising. Check your Learning Journey for progress.
student_home_sequence: Submit writing → Review feedback → Complete practice → Submit revision → Review your learning journey
student_home_boundary: All suggestions are formative research-prototype observations and are not proficiency or mastery judgments.
student_writing_subtitle: Submit a new essay or revise a previous draft.
student_writing_select_revision: Select the draft you are revising
student_writing_revision_note: This draft will be treated as a revision within the same writing task.
student_writing_no_candidates: No previous submissions found for revision. Submit a first draft first.
student_writing_submitting: Analyzing your writing and generating feedback...
student_feedback_subtitle: Your strengths and revision priorities from the latest submission.
student_feedback_no_strengths: No supported positive finding is available for this draft. This does not mean your writing lacks strengths — the prototype may not have identified one with sufficient confidence.
student_feedback_no_priority_desc: No sufficiently supported revision priority was identified for this draft. This does not mean your draft needs no revision — the prototype's diagnostic rules did not select a priority with enough confidence.
student_feedback_no_exercise: No targeted exercise was generated for this submission.
student_feedback_next_revise: Review the revision priorities above and consider revising your draft.
student_feedback_next_continue: Continue writing. Submit another essay or revision when ready.
student_feedback_no_result: No feedback available yet. Submit an essay from the Writing page first.
student_revision_subtitle: Review changes between drafts and observe revision patterns.
student_revision_no_result: No revision data available. Submit an essay with feedback first.
student_revision_no_history: No linked revision history is available. Submit a revision and explicitly choose its earlier draft to build a within-task trajectory.
student_revision_edit_note: High change ratios indicate extensive rewriting, not necessarily improvement.
student_revision_major_rewrite: The draft was substantially rewritten, limiting direct comparison with earlier feedback.
student_revision_no_previous: The earlier draft did not contain a selected priority that can be tracked.
student_revision_no_uptake: No revision response candidate was identified.
student_revision_boundary: These observations are descriptive candidates. They do not establish that feedback caused the changes, nor do they measure learning or improvement.
student_practice_source_placeholder: Copy the relevant sentence from your essay
student_practice_empty_response: Please write a response before submitting.
journey_recurrence: Target behavior observed in later task
journey_nonrecurrence: Target behavior not observed in later task
app_api_starting: The feedback API is starting up. Please wait a moment and try again.
app_api_failed: The feedback API failed to start. Check the terminal for details and restart run.bat.
error_service_not_running: The local service is not running. Start the application and try again.
error_service_starting: The local service is still starting up. Please wait a moment and try again.
error_service_degraded: The local service is running in a reduced mode. Some features may be unavailable.
error_service_failed: The local service failed to start. Check the terminal for details and restart the application.
error_request_timeout: The request took too long and was stopped. Please try again.
error_connection_interrupted: The connection was interrupted. Please try again.
error_resource_not_found: The requested learner or record was not found.
error_invalid_request: The request could not be processed because some information is invalid.
error_backend_processing_error: The action could not be completed. Please try again later.
error_invalid_response: The local service returned an unreadable response. Please try again.
error_provider_unavailable: The optional AI provider is unavailable, but local functionality may still work.
error_permission_privacy: This action is not allowed under the current privacy settings.
error_conflict_duplicate: This action appears to have already been completed. No duplicate was created.
error_unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
journey_enter_student_id: Enter a Student ID to view the learning journey.
journey_empty_boundary: This timeline shows only directly observable system records. It does not measure learning, proficiency, or ability change.
journey_event_revision_submitted_desc: A revised draft was submitted and linked to essay #{source}.
journey_event_analysis_completed_desc: Language analysis was completed for essay #{submission}.
journey_event_feedback_without_priority_: Feedback was generated for essay #{submission}, but no priority passed the Diagnostic Gate. Not every submission will generate practice.
journey_event_insufficient_evidence_desc: No analysis record exists for essay #{submission}; learning-process evidence is insufficient for this submission.
journey_event_practice_evaluation_record: The attempt was evaluated with conservative rule-based evidence.
journey_state_submission_without_analysi: Some submissions do not have an analysis record yet.
journey_state_analysis_without_priority: Feedback exists for some submissions, but no priority passed the Diagnostic Gate.
journey_state_feedback_no_practice_targe: No eligible practice target exists yet.
journey_state_target_no_attempt: A practice target exists, but no exercise attempt has been submitted.
journey_state_attempt_no_evaluation: An attempt exists, but no evaluation has been recorded.
journey_state_revision_no_response: A revision exists, but no supported revision-response observation exists.
journey_empty_no_submissions_desc: Learning journey events appear after essays are submitted and processed.
journey_empty_no_submissions_next: Next step: submit an essay on the Writing page.
journey_empty_no_analysis_desc: The submission exists but no analysis record is available yet.
journey_empty_no_analysis_next: Next step: recheck after analysis completes; not every submission will generate feedback.
journey_empty_no_priority_title: Feedback reviewed ? no practice priority yet
journey_empty_no_priority_desc: Feedback was generated, but no priority passed the Diagnostic Gate for these submissions.
journey_empty_no_priority_next: Not every submission will generate feedback or practice. You may submit another essay.
journey_empty_no_target_desc: Feedback exists, but no eligible practice target has been created.
journey_empty_no_target_next: Next step: check your feedback and write a new draft.
journey_empty_no_attempt_desc: A practice target exists, but no exercise attempt has been submitted.
journey_empty_no_attempt_next: Next step: open Practice and complete an exercise.
journey_empty_no_evaluation_desc: An attempt exists, but no evaluation has been recorded yet.
journey_empty_no_evaluation_next: Next step: revisit Practice to see the evaluation.
journey_empty_no_revision_desc: No revised draft has been submitted for this journey yet.
journey_empty_no_revision_next: Next step: revise your draft on the Writing page.
journey_empty_no_transfer_desc: No comparable later-task evidence exists; this is not a judgment about learning.
journey_empty_no_transfer_next: Next step: continue with a new independent task.
practice_exercise_loaded: Existing exercise loaded for this target (no duplicate created).
